meta.name: Genghis Khan
meta.description: This is the story of the shy Mongol boy Temujin who,during the 13th century, becomes the fearless Mongol leader Genghis Khan that unites all Mongol tribes and conquers India,China,Persia,Korea and parts of Rusia,Europe and Middle-East.
meta.slogan: Only once in the furied history of adventure and conquest...did one man rule so vast an empire!
